study.question: Can explicit target-content interactions in secondary compressed-block keys recover useful task/context retrieval over target-blind content addressing, beyond both frozen sources and the stronger uniform-summary incumbent, at unchanged parameter capacity and justified measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0050-content_keys_transfer scored0.6679138863 versus scored-key transfer0.6683505199 and uniform/incumbent0.6684573079; blocking auxiliary adapter-context gradients reversed the key contrast (content0.6682888456 versus scored0.6678264533). These matched-capacity, fixed-seed results show a key-source/transfer interaction, not a mechanism or statistical certainty. The unscored key omits target information even though its values are target-scored. A task/context query addressing elementwise target-times-content keys may provide target-conditioned local selection without multiplying keys by the signed learned scorer. Cross key interaction with auxiliary transfer to distinguish an addressing benefit from a gradient-gate rescue. Earlier pooled target modulation g0-r0047-target_triple0.6684064171 did not beat the incumbent; local key placement is an unverified alternative, not an inference that target modulation generally works.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived exact-version primary lines250-294; DIN makes interest pooling target-dependent and relaxes softmax normalization to preserve intensity. Inherit target local activation in signed values. Apply elementwise target/content interaction only to secondary ten-block normalized addressing with task/context queries, not original DIN reproduction. Target-conditioned attention and multiplicative feature interactions are prior ideas; no novelty claim.

Inspected pinned benchmark lines129-274, including feature+target tokenizer input and separate key/value projections. This implementation reuses fixed masked block means and existing rank16 history projection columns rather than adding independent key/value matrices, fixed query tokens, recent/earlier branches or a heterogeneous mixer. Original HeMix full paper is unavailable through the supplied text registry and remains unaudited; benchmark-code comparison does not prove original-method equivalence.

Standalone authorized source inspected. Keep its full code and modify only the key-input item coordinates to target*content; retain historical action coordinates, no current action read. The content controls replay both r0050 gates. All target-score-weighted values, original base/moment paths and module initialization remain inherited.

Receipt documents an unsuccessful target projection modulating the globally pooled context-history product with6144 extra parameters. Proposed local key interaction is before per-block attention, has no extra parameters, and leaves pooled fusion unchanged; this is a different implementation, not a refutation of the earlier negative result.

inherited_components: Full r0050 unscored-content retrieval implementation and its frozen input/masking boundary
DIN-derived signed action-aware local activation and native Dice populations with folded support execution
Uniform click and feedback auxiliary compressed values, five target-match/ordinal moment channels and four task towers
Task-specific residual adapters and rank16 context-history product with tied key/history weights and zero interaction-output initialization
Auxiliary item/action/scorer stop-gradient and crossed broad adapter-context gate; host loss/optimizers unchanged
study.proposed_difference: For each existing uniform compressed block mean k=[item content, historical action], construct k_target=[k_item elementwise-multiplied by current target item embedding, k_action]. Project with exactly the existing history-base columns, then inherited tanh/RMS keys and context-query softmax over occupied blocks. Values remain the inherited signed target-scored block contributions and occupied mass multiplier M. Content mode uses original k. Both raw/product arithmetic executes in all cells; only the selected key tensor reaches the graph. Pass already task-owned target into correction, so auxiliary targets are detached in training. Four standalone modules form key interaction(target_product/content) x auxiliary adapter-context transfer(enabled/blocked). No target-action embedding, new module, parameter, loss, state or history view.
predictions: At the frozen seed, target_keys_transfer should exceed content_transfer_replay on full-population click AUC; useful candidate selection additionally requires exceeding0.668457307890924 incumbent and both frozen source AUCs0.660646940486458/0.660163362657485 at justified measured cost.

Target-product minus content differences in both gate cells and their difference-in-differences distinguish key benefit from reliance on broad auxiliary gradient blocking. A positive transfer-cell effect is primary; a blocked-only effect supports a different restricted explanation and cannot confirm beneficial auxiliary transfer.

At common nonzero output weights, varying target item coordinates with fixed context, content, values, counts and moments can change target-product attention, whereas raw content attention is target-invariant. Historical action key coordinates remain unchanged. Ones on all target item coordinates recover raw keys; zero target coordinates need not yield uniform attention because historical action content survives.

No learned parameter or buffer count change: expected32192421 total,31793216 embedding,399205 dense from r0050 receipts. Content replay cells should match their r0050 counterpart predictions, gradients, buffers and fixed-seed metrics within declared native precision tolerance; not independent replications.

With zero interaction-output matrices all cells have the inherited initial predictions. Empty history has zero branch contribution; one occupied block gives multiplier1 and key-independent selected values. Masked history perturbations must be invariant. Differences by pre-existing empty/1..16/17..64/>64 bins are exploratory.
falsifiers: No transfer-cell AUC improvement over content replay leaves the proposed rescue unsupported. Failure to beat uniform/incumbent or benefit explained only by longer runtime fails useful quality-cost complementarity for this implementation, even if it beats the weaker key source.

A positive blocked-only contrast or a sign reversal across gates fails the hypothesis of useful target addressing with enabled auxiliary transfer. Retain the interaction and all negative cells; do not generalize one result to all query mechanisms.

At common nonzero outputs, target-product attention lacks target sensitivity on nondegenerate inputs, action coordinates are changed, or auxiliary target/item/action/scorer gradients appear: implementation or contract failure, not scientific counterevidence.

Changed module counts/order, inherited buffer updates, original base/value/moment paths, content replay mismatch, nonfinite FP32/BF16 forward/backward or masking/source leakage invalidates the comparison pending correction at charged cost.
A small one-seed gain that does not survive authorized paired repetitions or user-cluster uncertainty remains preliminary; withheld outcomes cannot repair or guide this open search.
alternative_explanations: Target-product and content keys differ in norm, sign, saturation and optimization despite RMS-normalized projections; a gain alone would not prove semantic matching
Shared embedding tables couple target/history gradients across samples; context gates affect both residual and interaction adapters
Single fixed training seed and adaptive selection across many previous rounds; validation improvement is preliminary and not a significance claim

Products can act as generic sign/scale gates or implicit regularizers rather than identify target-relevant blocks; a subsequent shuffled-target or norm-matched key control would be needed if the result is consequential.
Previous r0048 semantic grouping0.6681449281 and interleaving0.6680000567 both failed the uniform incumbent; stronger retrieval expressivity alone is not evidence of useful compression.

Auxiliary tasks sacrifice AUC versus the initial DIN baseline: incumbent auxiliary AUCs0.8079/0.8192/0.8309 versus baseline0.8491/0.8649/0.8702. Click is the frozen selection metric; this tradeoff must be reported, not hidden by mean-task metrics.

knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Task/context secondary block addressing with unchanged signed values and frozen four-task compression; not original DIN reproduction or verified novelty.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No target-sensitive key operation or useful matched-control improvement invalidates the local transfer hypothesis.
